author: Dawudis
body:
Hi!  This is BeastzWafflez, former MidnightHD.  I was banned for anti-KB which I do not have and would like to know why my brother Beast Pancakez was banned as well.  I do not have any proof to give other than letting everyone know that I did not have this KB, as well as my little brother who was banned as well.  There are four of us who play on this daily, myself, Beast Pancakez, Suli7 and my sister UnicornSniper, aka PinkiePie aka Yaazey.  Please let me know what I can do to submit for having myself unbanned as well as my little brother.  Thank you.

Sincerely,

BeastzWafflez

title: Please unban me and my little brother

replies.author: Dawudis
replies.body: So because we have bad ping that is why you are banning us?  That is your proof?  At 0:07 BeastPancakez took late knockback (or really bad internet ping) hit.  On mine crouching and shifting reduces my chances of being knocked off.  My stats show that I was killed by another person. To go into more detail, I was knocked off of it while making a bridge to the last monument of purple team. Even if you don't have proof of me being "knocked" off, then why didn't everyone else in the game report me and only itzDylan?  We don't have anti-knock back at all.  Please reconsider unbanning both of us.

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

First off, please have some patience with your appeal. I apologize about the Senior Staff's delayed response to you, however. 

It seems very obvious that you don't have bad ping and did not take any knockback whatsoever. The evidence is quite clear and you will not be appealed. I will appeal your brother, but you will not be appealed.

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator
